# tcpshield_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Lists the entries of a network's IP firewall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_firewall_rules" "all" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) Network to list.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR range, e.g. `203.0.113.0/24`; a single address needs `/32`. The API rejects a bare IP (`Invalid Cidr formatting`) and keeps host bits as written. The plan caps the number of entries (Pro: 5, Enterprise: 50) — one past the cap fails at apply.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric entry id.
- `whitelist` (Boolean) `true` allows the source, `false` blocks it.
